incident-bot: :warning: Alert: gpu-hotpath pool saturation detected. 429 spike > 35% over baseline across us-west-2. Paging oncall.

marta (oncall): I'm on it. seeing queue depth jump on hotpath from ~20 -> ~950 in 8m. GPU util at 98% on the hotpath nodes. Autoscaler logs show repeated 'scale limit reached' messages.

kevin (sre): can you paste autoscaler tail and rate limiter errors? also any customer impact flags?

marta (oncall): pulling logs now.

marta (oncall): logs snippet:
```
I0412 14:03:21 autoscaler.go:221] scaleCheck: desired=24 current=24 limit=24 reason=pool_max_size
E0412 14:04:02 ratelimiter.go:87] tokenbucket: drop request=acme-analytics tenant=acme tokens=0 burst=50 window=60s
E0412 14:04:02 runtime.go:412] serve: 429 Too Many Requests: upstream token bucket exhausted
```

dinesh: looks like pool max hit + tokenbucket exhausted for tier=hotpath. We rate-limit aggressively at tier policy default during surge which makes burst smoothing worse when autoscaler can't scale.

eva: customer alert from acme-alert-bot: "Acme Analytics: 30% error rate on /v1/inference since 14:02 UTC". They've flagged latency-sensitive pipelines. cc @jamie (eng) who's the SE for Acme.

jamie (eng): confirming. Their job retries are amplifying the load. They use synchronous calls with small batch sizes.

opsbot: Runbook hint -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-saturation : see section "tokenbucket + autoscaler interplay".

marta (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) relax token bucket for hotpath tier temporarily 2) lift pool_max_size for hotpath by +4 nodes (if infra allows) 3) apply immediate routing fallback to smaller model for non-critical customers 4) notify Acme and put their traffic onto dedicated spare pool if possible. Executing in that order.

kevin (sre): +1. I'll prepare the control-plane patch to adjust tokenbucket window/burst. marta, can you confirm API to change tier config? opsbot gave the API earlier.

kevin (sre): cURL patch (going to run):
```
curl -X PATCH https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/policies/hotpath-tokenbucket \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"burst":200, "window_seconds":60, "rate":400}'
```

marta (oncall): applying now.

marta (oncall): Patch applied. control-plane returned 200. opsbot: please verify policy propagated to edge proxies.

opsbot: policy propagation: ok -> proxies/us-west-2: all nodes report new tokenbucket config within 20s :white_check_mark:

marta (oncall): triggering pool resize: patching pool max from 24 -> 28. command:
```
kubectl -n inference patch pool/gpu-hotpath --type merge -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":28}}'
```

dinesh: autoscaler logs now showing scale up start. expect new nodes online in ~3-6m. Keep 1.5x watch on queue.

(2m later)

marta (oncall): nodes coming up. GPU util dropping to mid 80s. queue depth trending down to ~320.

jamie (eng): Acme responded. We've rerouted their non-critical jobs to fallback model and reducing retry logic on their side. They see errors dropping.

marta (oncall): 429 rate dropped from 35% -> 8% in 7m. Latency p50 increased slightly from 60ms -> 85ms for hotpath due to extra scheduling, but overall success improved.

kevin (sre): temporary mitigations applied. Next steps: - revert tokenbucket to normal after stabilization - investigate why pool_max_size was reached (we may need to bump target or improve predictive scaling) - postmortem + follow-up actions.

eva: logging customer impact: Acme saw 30% failure, 2 retries failed, some delayed pipelines. Add to incident ticket.

marta (oncall): I'm going to hand off monitoring to kevin for the next 6 hours. Summary for handoff: saturated hotpath due to unexpected backup and customer retries; autoscaler hit pool_max_size; tokenbucket exhaustion caused 429 amplification; mitigations: temporary tokenbucket bump, increased pool max (+4), routed Acme to fallback pool & smaller model; monitoring shows 429s now <10% and falling. Link to logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/explore?query=gpu_hotpath+errors

kevin (sre): taking over. I'll keep auto-scaling watching and schedule a canary run of smarter pre-warming autoscale rule overnight. Also will create a temporary metric alert for tokenbucket refill failures.

marta (oncall): thanks — created follow-up backlog items: #1 adjust default burst/window for hotpath tiers #2 audit per-tenant burst allocations #3 add autoscaler runbook step to increase maxReplicas safely #4 contact Acme for formal RCA.

jamie (eng): :+1: I'll coordinate with Acme SE to adjust client retry behavior and suggest batched calls to reduce pressure.

kevin (sre): I'll update this thread if anything regresses. Otherwise will start the postmortem doc tomorrow. tagging @oncall-sre for visibility :eyes:

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and assigned to kevin (sre). Severity: Sev2 -> monitoring.

marta (oncall): handing off. logging off in 10m. :white_check_mark:

kevin (sre): got it. signing on. I'll capture a timeline and add the postmortem link when available.

acme-alert-bot: Acme Analytics: error rate normalized to 4%. Thank you for the mitigation.

marta (oncall): thanks everyone. closing active mitigation. follow-ups tracked in the incident ticket.
